name: Simple Rune
summary: In Coldridge Valley, Thran Khorman sends promising young dwarven warriors to Anvilmar for training with the Simple Rune.

sections.title: A Summons to Arms
sections.body: Young fighters who have begun clearing threats from Coldridge Valley receive Thran’s formal summons. The rune’s martial marks hold no magic; they tell each recruit to report to Thran inside Anvilmar. There, he teaches basic combat and gives practical advice for surviving Dun Morogh’s hostile wilds.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Simple Rune?
faq.answer: The Simple Rune directs recruits to seek formal instruction from Thran Khorman inside Anvilmar. Young warriors in Coldridge Valley receive it as an instructional tablet.
Thran Khorman sends the Simple Rune. The dwarf warrior trainer inside Anvilmar watches for promising fighters who help around the valley.

faq.q: Where do I take the Simple Rune?
faq.answer: Take the Simple Rune to Thran Khorman inside Anvilmar, in central Coldridge Valley.

angles.text: As a dwarven warrior, the Simple Rune marks your first step into formal training under veteran instructor Thran Khorman.
As a dwarf, Thran Khorman’s rune offers you the basics of the fight: an axe’s grip, armor’s weight, and the sweat of real battle.
